name: peft-bench-metrics
description: A dataset that collects evaluation metrics for experiments applying parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods to language models. It consolidates per-task performance metrics to facilitate comparison between different PEFT approaches across downstream tasks and configurations. Intended for benchmarking efficiency vs. performance trade-offs when adapting large language models.
reputation: A practitioner-oriented Hugging Face resource used by researchers and engineers experimenting with PEFT approaches, but not a broadly standardized community benchmark.
